onset.Description: Trial rows: balloon inflation start ('start inflating'); censored rows: start of the censored interval. Times as stored in bart.hdf5 relative to the first LFP sample of the recording

duration.Description: Trial rows: 'stop inflating' - 'start inflating'; censored rows: interval length

trial_type.Description: balloon = one BART trial; censored = interval marked artifactual for one channel (bart.hdf5 /censor)

Levels.censored: artifact interval of the channel in column 'channel'

ctrltime.Description: Computer-generated random inflate time (control trials only)

inflate_time.Description: Time the balloon inflated before popping or being stopped

result.Description: banked = success (balloon stopped), popped = balloon popped

banked.Description: Time the participant stopped the balloon (n/a if popped), seconds since task start

popped.Description: Time the balloon popped (n/a if stopped), seconds since task start

outcome.Description: Time the outcome was displayed, seconds since task start

start_inflating.Description: Time the balloon started inflating, seconds since task start

stop_inflating.Description: Time the balloon stopped inflating, seconds since task start

trial_start.Description: Time the trial began, seconds since task start

trial_over.Description: Time the trial ended, seconds since task start

trial_start_time.Description: Trial start time recorded by PsychoPy (PsychoPy clock)
